reviews.thm-aa-plus-and-a-plus-a-are-orthogonal-: Reviewed the repaired SVD proof for arbitrary rectangular real or complex matrices, including rank zero and full rank. The transposed-shape pseudoinverse is obtained by a direct Penrose-equation check, both products are self-adjoint idempotents, and their ranges are exactly the nonzero left and right singular subspaces.
reviews.thm-pseudoinversion-is-continuous-on-eac: Reviewed both branches separately. On a fixed-rank stratum the positive singular values stay separated from zero along every convergent subsequence, while compactness of the orthogonal or unitary factors supplies convergent subsubsequences; the rank-changing diagonal family gives the required unbounded inverse and covers the discontinuity boundary.
reviews.thm-eigenpair-residual-realises-the-mini: Reviewed the unit-vector normalization, the induced spectral-norm lower bound, and the real and complex rank-one witness E=-rx*. Cauchy--Schwarz gives the matching upper bound, equality is attained at x, and the zero-residual case correctly returns the zero perturbation.
reviews.ex-a-piecewise-quadratic-distribution-fu: Reviewed monotonicity and right continuity of the piecewise function, every endpoint and truncated half-open interval case, and local finiteness of both Borel measures. Their interval increments agree with the integral of 2x on [0,1], so the uniqueness theorem applies and the stated density follows.
reviews.cex-x-inverse-dlambda-on-zero-one-shows-: Reviewed absolute continuity through null-set integration, sigma-finiteness of the density measure by exhaustion away from zero, and failure of the uniform small-set estimate. For every positive delta, the interval starting at zero has Lebesgue mass below delta while its x^{-1} integral is infinite.
reviews.cex-an-absolutely-continuous-finite-meas: Reviewed finiteness, absolute continuity, and the common exhaustion for the density x^{-1/2} on (0,1]. Its integral is 2, while for every bound M the set where the density exceeds M contains a positive-measure interval, so no almost-everywhere representative is essentially bounded.
reviews.fs-the-epsilon-delta-condition-character: Reviewed the same x^{-1} density as a direct refutation of the unrestricted statement. Null-set integration proves absolute continuity, but epsilon=1 defeats every proposed delta because an interval adjacent to zero has arbitrarily small base measure and infinite density measure.
reviews.fs-absolutely-continuous-measures-always: Reviewed the finite absolutely continuous witness with density x^{-1/2} on (0,1]. The density is integrable but essentially unbounded: every level set above a finite threshold contains an interval of positive Lebesgue measure, so changing values on a null set cannot make the derivative bounded.
reviews.fs-the-image-of-every-immersion-is-an-em: Reviewed the figure-eight map globally. The chain rule gives derivative (cos t,2 cos 2t), whose two coordinates never vanish simultaneously, so the map is an immersion; the two preimages of the origin have distinct tangent lines, producing a transverse crossing that is not locally a one-manifold slice.
